description: You are a special education teacher at Sunrise Academy setting up GCompris for a student named Marcus who has significant cognitive learning challenges and needs only the most accessible activities. GCompris educational software is open on the screen. Your task is to: (1) Open the GCompris configuration/settings panel (accessible through a gear or settings icon in the application) and change the difficulty filter so that ONLY the lowest-difficulty activities (maximum difficulty level 3) are displayed — reducing the activity pool to the most accessible content. (2) After applying the new difficulty settings, navigate through both the Math/Numbers category and the Language/ABC category to observe which activities are now visible at this restricted level. (3) Run at least 2 of the most accessible activities to personally verify they are appropriate for Marcus. (4) Write an Individual Accommodation Plan to ~/Desktop/accommodation_plan.txt documenting: the difficulty settings you applied, a list of accessible Math activities visible at this difficulty level, a list of accessible Language activities visible at this difficulty level, and a recommended 5-day weekly activity schedule for Marcus. Login: ga / password123
